findings.evidence: typeProjection (319) is a polynomial in alternatingDerivation for arbitrary J. Derivation naturality is already unconditional (151, 164), and aeval_comp_of_comp_eq (279) transports polynomial evaluation. For conjugate-linear maps, conjugating the Lagrange polynomial swaps p and q because conjugation negates every type eigenvalue.
findings.fix: Prove these identities directly from polynomial evaluation and derivation naturality, retaining only hf or hL; remove hJ and hK and the extra real scalar continuity assumptions used by the decomposition proofs.
findings.issue: Remove the square-minus-identity assumptions from typeProjection_compContinuousLinearMap, typeProjection_compContinuousAlternatingMap (614), and typeProjection_compContinuousAlternatingMap_of_map_smul_conj (632). They unnecessarily restrict naturality to almost complex structures.

summary: The projection naturality API unnecessarily requires almost complex structures; these polynomial identities hold for arbitrary endomorphisms.
